# jcooperkai

> Personal site of jcooperkai (Cooper E.), an agentic engineer in San Diego. It lists my company, my public projects, and how to reach me.

- Site: https://jcooperkai.com/
- GitHub: https://github.com/jcooperkai-sys
- X: https://x.com/jcooperkai
- Email: jcooperkai@gmail.com

## Company

- [Webbify](https://webbify.build/): my company. AI agents rebuild and run small-business websites, each with a live client dashboard.

## Projects

- [HisokaOS](https://github.com/jcooperkai-sys/HisokaOS): A from-scratch 32-bit x86 operating system in C and assembly.
- [Transactional Relational Database Engine](https://github.com/jcooperkai-sys/TRDE): A transactional relational database engine in pure Python.
- [The Lazy Driver](https://github.com/jcooperkai-sys/The-Lazy-Driver): Self-driving perception and path prediction on dashcam footage.
- [Bill](https://github.com/jcooperkai-sys/Bill): A local conversational system with memory, retrieval and fact checking.
- [Reachy RL](https://github.com/jcooperkai-sys/Reachy-RL): Reachy 2 in MuJoCo, set up for reinforcement learning.
- [GGUF Token Decoder](https://github.com/jcooperkai-sys/GGUF-Token-Decoder): Decodes a GGUF model's token IDs using only the model file.
- [Editor Browser](https://github.com/jcooperkai-sys/Editor-Browser): A full browser tab inside the VS Code editor.
- [App Installer](https://github.com/jcooperkai-sys/app-installer): A Windows application with an NSIS installer.
